## Highlights
### Fixed
- On Chromium pages, a window a site opens and fills in itself, such as presentation speaker notes or a Slack huddle, now shows its content instead of staying blank. - On Chromium pages, a site that asks to share its own tab now asks in Crest's sharing picker over the page, instead of in a separate window. - On Chromium, Copy, Cut, Paste and the other Edit shortcuts work in extension popups and side panels. - On Chromium, an extension's toolbar icon shows the count its blocking rules report, such as uBlock Origin Lite's blocked requests. - On Chromium pages, when this Mac has no passkey for a site, signing in with a passkey now offers your phone's QR code or a security key instead of stopping at "No passkeys available". - On Chromium pages, sites that check for Touch ID before offering it, such as Duo, now offer it when this Mac can keep passkeys. - On Chromium, a private or trusted-tester Chrome Web Store extension installs in a Space signed in to an account that can see it, instead of failing with HTTP 401. - On Chromium pages, dragging an item or a link no longer leaves the page unable to take clicks until it reloads.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
